mech_summary: Channel-move spin dealing weapon hits in a radius while walking; the genre's modern spin-to-win reference and the premier CoC host body.
Self-burn aura: the body is permanently on fire, damaging everything nearby while regeneration out-heals the self-damage; the walk-forward tank archetype.
Each strike adds self-damaging trauma stacks that raise the skill's damage — an escalating self-harm ramp balanced against armour and recovery.
Physical bleed DoT stacking with max-block defense; hit once, watch them bleed out while blocking everything.
Slam now, aftershock later — a delayed second larger hit teaches the genre's plant-and-payoff rhythm.
Slam raises rock spikes that shatter on warcry — a two-step plant-then-detonate slam loop; top 3.28 starter per curated lists.
Auto-teleporting strike chains from enemy to enemy fueled by frenzy charges — the screen plays itself while the pilot holds one button; the genre's beloved chaos-movement icon.
Melee hit sprays fire projectiles that rain back down around the target — strike-emits-projectiles; the Uber Elder era's boss-killer throne.
Channel to stack, release to detonate the stored stacks in one burst — the channel-and-release commitment archetype.
Melee strike that also fires converted-lightning projectiles forward — melee and ranged in one button; the modern era's dominant strike skill.
Cold strike whose hits throw icy projectiles to targets behind — the cold sibling of the strike-plus-projectiles family.
Thrown weapon corkscrews outward in a helix, hitting along its spiral path — projectile with rotational micro-motion.
Weapon copy flies out and RETURNS through enemies, hitting on both passes — the boomerang dr/dt sign-flip in shipped canon; 1.x's Ele Buzzsaw was the era's named king.
Throws a copy of the shield that shatters into shrapnel; damage scales off shield defenses — gear-stat-as-weapon oddity.
Warcry summons mirage warriors from corpses who each perform YOUR linked attack — the player's skill executed by temporary echoes; corpse-fueled.

proxy.note: mirages execute player skill — novel proxy mode

mech_summary: Endurance-charge-consuming fire slam with fissure spray; charge-spender slam identity.
Fast poison-stacking strikes where kills burst remaining poison to neighbors — DoT melee with contagion pops.
Thrown poison projectiles that RETURN and are caught, then re-released in a burst via Whirling Blades — catch-and-release ammo economy on a boomerang path.
Unique gloves multiply unarmed damage — no weapon at all; the item IS the build, punching the genre in the face for a decade.
Arrow flies to a point then bursts into secondary arrows in all directions — projectile-spawns-projectiles; the endgame magic-find throne for a decade.
Lightning arrow splashes to nearby enemies per hit; chain+proj scaling makes it the modern mapping archetype of record.
Wand shots explode in clustered secondary blasts around impact — screen-paint clearing; the named wander MF archetype, refreshed by the 3.27 wand rework.
Each attack rolls ONE random element at huge values; Combat Focus rings delete unwanted elements to force the roll — RNG-element bow burst.

elem_p.note: stochastic element selection — no stable primary

mech_summary: Arrows rain pods that slow and tick chaos DoT in overlapping zones — the perennial low-budget league-start king.
Arrow leaves a caustic ground cloud ticking chaos DoT — the original ground-DoT bow archetype, TR's ancestor.
Channel to grow thorn charge stages, release a spore-pod fan — bow channel-and-release with poison stacking.
Cold arrow with a cone splash behind the target; Asenath's chant-era mapping darling.
Wide arrow fan applying stacked bleeds with Gladiator explosion pops — physical DoT at range.
Ballista totems stack explosive arrows into a target that detonate in one massive ignite — totem-delivered fuse-stack bossing royalty.
Piercing cold pulse that decays with distance — the founding-era caster staple; closer is deadlier.
Thrown mines detonate cascading ice eruptions marching forward in a line — deploy-then-detonate caster at mine cadence.
Channel to charge a floating orb above the caster that autonomously machine-guns frost bolts at nearby enemies while you run — charge-then-coast turret-over-shoulder.
Instant-cast Vortex ground chill plus Creeping Frost clouds tick cold DoT while the CI/ES body facetanks — the safest league-starter archetype of its era.
Channel to grow a circle through ten stages, release an enormous fire nova at full size — the genre's purest charge-and-detonate spell.
Channeled flamethrower whose damage ramps in stages the longer you hold — the founding-era sustained-channel archetype.
Explodes a corpse for a percentage of the corpse's life as fire — damage scaled by the VICTIM'S body, with corpse-spawning spells as ammunition factories.

econ.note: GAP-D2-04 cross-game confirm — corpse economy load-bearing in PoE too

mech_summary: Brand attaches to an enemy and periodically calls meteors on it while you run; recall and re-throw — attach-an-emitter-to-the-target caster.
Hexblast consumes the curse on the target for a huge chaos hit; mine cadence automates the curse-then-consume loop — ailment mark-and-detonate.
Unique wands auto-cast socketed spells on attack — attack-triggered Volatile Dead orbs seek and detonate off Unearth corpses; the item-trigger loop that defined an era.

proxy.note: seeking orbs; on-attack item trigger — hook-layer evidence

mech_summary: An expanding wave crosses the screen applying exposure and one giant scaled ignite — single-big-DoT-per-target caster.
THE chain lightning: bolt hops target to target with per-chain damage growth; the reference chain-geometry caster across every delivery system the game ever offered.
Sprays duration projectiles that wander randomly, bouncing off walls until they find flesh — corridor-flooding stochastic swarm; reborn as the modern Inquisitor mapping monster.
Slow orb drifts forward zapping everything near it many times per second — slower projectile means MORE hits; the inverse-velocity damage oddity.
Brand attaches and periodically zaps nearby enemies with chaining lightning while you keep moving — the set-and-forget attached-turret caster.
Channel gathers charge by zapping nearby enemies, release fires a screen-length annihilation beam — gather-then-lance.
Branching lightning beam whose intensity ramps while you stand and cast, resetting on move — the stand-your-ground ramp caster.
Consumes the shock on enemies for a massive hit scaled by shock magnitude — apply the ailment, then cash it in; ailment mark-and-consume.
Mechanic-modifier archetype: lightning spell damage scales off unreserved MANA — the resource pool IS the weapon and (via MoM) the shield; hosts Ball Lightning, Spark, Manabond.
Thrown trap arms on the ground and erupts when enemies step near, leaving burning ground — deploy-and-bait; the founding trap archetype.
Essence Drain ticks chaos DoT; Contagion makes the DoT JUMP to neighbors on death — a two-button plague that clears rooms by spreading. The genre's reference contagion loop.
One cast applies chaos DoT AND every linked curse simultaneously — the curse-bundler damage spell.
Homing chaos projectile that drains life into energy shield as it passes through packs, leaving DoT — damage that FEEDS the defense.
Unique armour projects Death Aura — constant chaos DoT around the walking body; the item IS the build, RF's chaos cousin with zero buttons.
The spell costs LIFE and deals chaos nova plus seeking projectiles; totem delivery makes the totems pay the blood price instead — self-damage economy outsourced to proxies.

aliases: PConc of Bouncing(3.27 transfigured, Slayer/GC variant)
mech_summary: UNARMED flask-thrower: lobs exploding poison vials whose damage scales off LIFE FLASK charges — the consumable-charge pool as ammunition; league-start royalty, refreshed by the 3.27 transfigured Bouncing variant.
Stacks up to ten spinning blades ORBITING the body, each hitting everything nearby on rotation — maintain the stack, walk into packs, everything melts; the body-orbit anchor of the genre.

geo.note: body-orbit blade ring — rotational family anchor evidence

mech_summary: Bladefall volleys leave lingering blades stuck in the ground; Blade Blast DETONATES every lingering blade in a chain of explosions — plant the field, then set it off.
Chaining chaos nova that SACRIFICES skeleton life to fuel its damage — or your own life if no skeletons; minions as batteries, the self-damage economy with a proxy twist.
Machine-gun a stream of temporary flaming-skull minions that fly at enemies and expire seconds later — minions as AMMUNITION rather than army; cast rate is your trigger finger.
Unique jewel converts summoned skeletons into a firing squad of bolt-casting mages — a jewel flips the minion's entire delivery mode; army-of-casters archetype.
The Baron helm feeds the caster's stacked STRENGTH into zombie power and life-leech-per-minion — a gear stat on YOUR sheet becomes the ARMY'S engine.
Raise permanent copies of MAP MONSTERS as your army — the game's entire enemy roster becomes the build space; which corpse you bind defines the kit. RDR's possession fantasy, minion-flavored.
Primordial jewels turn the golem menagerie into the whole build — each golem type contributes a distinct aura-buff while fighting; the pet-with-passive-slot army.
YOUR poison hits do nothing but feed virulence stacks to a scorpion crawler pet who does ALL the killing — the player is the pet's ammunition loader.
Animates weapons LYING ON THE GROUND as temporary sword-minions — loot literally becomes ammunition; the drop stream is the resource pool.
Totems perform your melee slams while you stand nearby buffing them — melee outsourced to deployed ancestors; the player is a coach on a proximity leash.
Totems channel Flameblast to full stages and detonate, over and over — the CHANNEL COMMITMENT outsourced to proxies; you just place the pizza sticks and walk.

commit.note: proxies absorb the channel commitment — commitment-transfer evidence

mech_summary: Iron Commander grants +1 ballista per 200 DEX — the attribute stack literally COUNTS your turret army; stat-as-army-size.
Thrown trap releases a SEQUENCE of shockwave pulses over its duration — deploy a metronome, stack several, and bosses stand in a pulse grid.
Throw mine clusters while running, detonate for converging icicle volleys — the throw-and-detonate two-beat rhythm at maximum tempo; league-start royalty of its era.

Cyclone crits machine-gun Ice Novas through Cast-on-Crit and Cospri's Malice — attack RATE becomes cast RATE; the community tunes attack speed to trigger-cooldown breakpoints like watchmakers. The hook-layer flagship.
The hammer casts socketed lightning spells every time you HIT with it — melee swings as spell triggers; the founding item-trigger legend alongside Poet's Pen and Cospri's.
Consumes ALL your charges at once for a nova scaled per charge consumed — build the stack, dump the stack; the genre's reference resource-dump payoff.
Self-damage sources feed Cast-when-Damage-Taken, whose triggered spells cause more self-damage — a closed automation circuit; the build casts itself while you walk.
Skeletons die instantly, Heartbound Loop self-damages you, CWDT recasts skeletons, Olroth's ward absorbs it all — a PERPETUAL MOTION cast engine; the most famous zero-button build ever engineered.
Herald of Ice shatters and Inpulsa explosions chain automatically as you RUN past packs — no attack button in the loop at all; movement is the engagement verb.

commit.note: no-button engagement — movement IS the verb

mech_summary: Reserve EVERYTHING — a dozen-plus auras whose stacked effect multiplies into absurd offense and defense at once; the full-reservation economy as the entire build.

econ.note: Axis-5 reserved-bin OCCUPANT — pre-registered prediction confirmed

mech_summary: Reserves the entire resource pool to project auras onto ALLIES — a build with near-zero personal damage whose output is other players' power; the party-role archetype.

proxy.note: allies are the payload — exceeds solo frame

ctrl.note: support role exceeds ctrl enum — party-layer

mech_summary: Reserve life down to Low Life for Pain Attunement's more-damage while Shavronne's makes chaos hit ES instead — LIVING at the bottom of one pool to supercharge the other; the reservation-economy mechanic archetype.
The staff grants Icestorm whose damage AND duration scale per 10 Intelligence — the purest attribute-stack-as-weapon build in the genre; a decade of guide lineages.

Writhing Jar flasks SPAWN worms — friendly kill-fodder — so attacks always have something to crit, machine-gunning Cast-on-Crit spells at bosses with no adds; the consumable that manufactures its own trigger targets.

Every BLOCK restores energy shield via Aegis Aurora — at capped block chance the defense refills itself faster than bosses can spend it; a mechanic archetype where the shield IS the build and damage skills are interchangeable passengers.

def.note: block-recovery loop — defense IS the engine

mech_summary: Flagship 3.15 minion that EATS your other minions to sustain itself — the anti-synergy killed it; clunky, starving, never found a meta despite buffs. Buffed-because-dead exemplar.

Strike converts to a RANDOM element with a random secondary effect per hit — the stochastic-element gimmick without Elemental Hit's numbers; scaling three elements at once priced it out of viability for a decade.

elem_s.note: tri-element scaling tax = the failure cause

mech_summary: The 360-degree melee swing that every other AOE melee skill simply outclassed for ten years — no identity hook, no numbers, the reference boring-dead skill.
Single-target cold thwack whose entire cultural footprint is jokes — freeze gimmick never paid for the missing AOE; the community's shorthand for a bad build.

Channel to project a mirage along your path, release to teleport and damage the corridor — movement-as-damage with so much friction (channel lock, mirage lag, payoff delay) that nobody kept it; THE contrastive negative for the movement-verb family.

mob.note: movement-damage inversion FAILURE — pairs with Flicker success

mech_summary: Dual-wield frontal arc that spent a decade as the skill you replace by act two — perpetually one tier below whatever else was in the slot; steady-state negative canon.
